commitResults.messageTitle: DeleteCommand: improve invalid index error messages
commitResults.messageBody:
Delete command shows the same invalid index message for all out-of-range
cases.

Using the same message is less helpful when the contact list is empty or
contains only one contact.

Let's return more specific messages for those edge cases while keeping the
general invalid index message for larger lists.

single-contact lists.

behaviour.

an empty field.
